text:
Situation: Propranolol hydrochloride injection has been on FDA's shortage list since 2023-10-31 for Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC and Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., and both remain Current as of the 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-14 updates. As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 36 months. Corvale East holds 92 tablets (7.5 days) and Corvale General holds 425.44 tablets (29.3 days), both labeled by Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 590126 at FEI 1000519407 ended 2009-06-11 and was classified OAI with six observations including lack of a written stability program. Subsequent inspections at the same FEI were classified VAI, most recently inspection 1326578 ending 2026-07-16 with classification letter 2026-10-14.

Our position: We have limited supply at Corvale East and adequate supply at Corvale General. Alternate manufacturers A-S Medication Solutions, AMICI PHARMACEUTICALS LLC, Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC, and American Health Packaging are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 81 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from A-S Medication Solutions — needs buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from AMICI PHARMACEUTICALS LLC — needs buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC — needs buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from American Health Packaging — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions; those decisions belong to treating clinicians and the committee.
